**Unblocked — `Blocked-by: #6004` resolves. ⚠️ Re-measure before dispatch: the merge that closed it changed this card's terrain.**

#6004 closed `completed` on 2026-08-26T02:16:37Z via merged PR #6461, *"type ObjectGrid's column emit against the TableColumn[] slot it fills"*.

Re-read from `main` as part of the unlock:

- `packages/plugin-grid/src/ObjectGrid.tsx` — `generateColumns` is now `useCallback((): ObjectGridColumnDraft[] => {`; the call site's `(col: any)` re-widening is gone.
- `packages/types/src/data-display.ts` — `TableColumn` is **unchanged**, and in particular still declares `width` and **not** `size`. So the mismatch this card reports — the persisted column width written as `size`, a key the consumer never reads — is still live, and it is now live *through a typed boundary*, which is a stronger statement than the card could make when it was filed.

⚠️ Second reason to re-measure, unrelated to #6004: this card also references #6259, which closed on 2026-08-25 via PR #6305 and moved the `width` / `size` vocabulary on the *navigation overlay* seam. That is a different seam from column persistence and does not decide this card — but anyone working here should read #6303 first so the two `width`-vs-`size` questions do not get conflated into one change.

Returned to `pm:queue`, not dispatched this round. ⛔ Do not implement from this card's body as written; its line numbers and `(col as any)` framing describe a pre-#6461 file.

Sibling cards unblocked by the same closure, same warning: #6424, #6425, #6458, #6459.

**⚠️ Correction: this seat's unlock comment above contains a false claim.** Full measurement and proof on #6458 ([correction comment](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/issues/6458#issuecomment-5427568668)).

I wrote here that *"`generateColumns` is now `useCallback((): ObjectGridColumnDraft[] => {`; the call site's `(col: any)` re-widening is gone."* Both of those are true — but the conclusion this seat drew from them across five cards, that the `any` hole is closed, is **false**. #6461 typed the **return** and the call-site map callback, not the **reads inside the body**. Seven `(col as any).` reads survive on `main`.

⛔ Do not dispatch this card on the premise that the cast route is gone. It is not, and whether that matters for *this* card's subject — the persisted column width written as `size`, a key `data-table` never reads — needs its own measurement rather than inheritance from a claim that turned out to be about the function signature.

The rest of the unlock note stands: `TableColumn` still declares `width` and not `size`, and the `width`-vs-`size` question on the **navigation overlay** seam (#6303, #6259, now tracked for its open half on #6584) is a different seam from column persistence and does not decide this card.

## ⛔ Do NOT implement from this card's body as written

Its line numbers and its `(col as any)` framing describe a **pre-#6461** file. Re-take the seam on today's `main`.

## What is measured and still live

The unlock re-read confirmed the defect survived #6461, and in a form the card could not claim when filed:

- `packages/types/src/data-display.ts` — **`TableColumn` still declares `width` and NOT `size`**, unchanged by #6461.
- `packages/plugin-grid/src/ObjectGrid.tsx` — `generateColumns` is now `useCallback((): ObjectGridColumnDraft[] => {`, and the call site's `(col: any)` re-widening is gone.

⇒ The persisted column width is written as `size`, a key the consumer never reads — and it is now live **through a typed boundary**, which is a stronger statement than the original card could make.

**The corroboration is in the same file**: the *grouped* path's own `width` stamp works. So this is one path out of step with its sibling, not a missing convention.

## ⚠️ A retracted false claim sits on this card — do not re-derive it

A prior seat wrote here that the `any` hole #6004 existed to close "is closed", and **retracted it**: #6461 typed the **return** and the call-site map callback, **not** the reads inside the body; seven `(col as any).` reads survive. ⛔ Do not dispatch on that premise, and ⛔ do not treat re-deriving it as a new finding. Whether the cast route matters for *this* card's subject needs its own measurement rather than inheritance.

## ⭐ The test shape is the deliverable, and triage named it

> pin the **INBOUND** half — a seeded width reaching the rendered column. The outbound-only pin is the measured reason this stayed invisible.

An outbound assertion ("we wrote a width") passes on the broken code, because the write is exactly what is wrong. **The pin has to start from a persisted value and end at the rendered column.** ⛔ A test that only checks what gets persisted does not test this card and would have shipped the bug again.

## ⛔ Do not conflate two different `width`-vs-`size` questions

There is a **separate** `width` / `size` vocabulary question on the **navigation overlay** seam (#6303, #6259 — closed via PR #6305; its open half is tracked on #6584). That is a different seam and ⛔ does not decide this card. Read #6303 first only so the two do not get merged into one change.

## PM mechanism assumptions — measure them; your reading wins

I have re-read the thread but **not** re-measured the tree today. Confirm on `main`: that `TableColumn` still declares `width` and not `size`; that the ungrouped `persistedColumns` path still stamps `size`; and that the grouped path still stamps `width` (that is your control — if it has changed, the "one path out of step" framing is wrong and you should say so).

Deliver a **draft** PR targeting `main` with `Fixes #6457`.
